newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore bunkers firmer on improved enquiries.
newsitem.headline: Singapore bunkers firmer on improved enquiries.

text.p: Singapore bunker quotes moved slightly higher on Thursday amid improved enquiries but some suppliers said they were unable to lift their cargoes due to berth congestion.
"Enquiries are improving but I can not promise too many deals because of the berth congestion," said one supplier. Some traders said the congestion may last until the end of June.
The 380-cst grade was quoted at about $97/$99 per tonne while the 180-cst grade was at $102/$105. MDO and gas oil were quoted lower to $170/$175 and $180/$183 per tonne respectively.
